scientific_integrity: Universal claims proved analytically; reproducibility program supplies finite, non-certifying support; literature priority is qualified and independently unvalidated.
scientific_limitations: Fixed tumbling/trap ratio, isotropic athermal harmonic RTP, dimension first then radial endpoint; neither finite-d uniform edge limits nor interactions, anisotropy, or thermal noise are covered. The stationary GEM construction and all-d finite moments are prior work.
title: Non-self-averaging high-dimensional radii and Gaussian-mixture fluctuations of harmonically trapped run-and-tumble particles
